neck.name: Neck and head
neck.causes: Sitting for long hours at a monitor, a poor sleeping position, stress and built-up tension in the upper trapezius.
neck.treatmentDesc: Focused release of spasms in the neck, shoulders and base of the skull for immediate relief from headaches and stiffness.

shoulders.name: Shoulders and trapezius
shoulders.causes: Raised shoulders when working at a computer, carrying a heavy backpack or a bag on one shoulder, chronic muscle tightness.
shoulders.treatmentTitle: Sports Massage for Back and Shoulders
shoulders.treatmentDesc: Deep muscle work on the shoulder blade area, trigger point release and a return to the full range of motion.

upper_back.name: Upper back and shoulder blades
upper_back.causes: A hunched posture, overstretched paravertebral muscles and strain from long drives or typing.
upper_back.treatmentDesc: Intense work on the muscle layers between the shoulder blades, better circulation and a straighter posture.

lower_back.name: Lower back (lumbar area)
lower_back.tag: Chronic fatigue and a sedentary lifestyle
lower_back.causes: An inactive core, tight hip muscles, long static sitting on a chair and lifting weight the wrong way.
lower_back.treatmentDesc: Relieves the pressure on the lower spine, relaxes the lumbar fascia and releases the deep muscles.

hips.name: Hip and glutes
hips.causes: Shortened hip flexors from sitting, and irritation of the piriformis muscle that can cause pain down the leg (pseudo-sciatica).
hips.treatmentTitle: Sports Massage for the Lower Body
hips.treatmentDesc: Therapeutic mobilization of the gluteal muscles and pelvic girdle with specialized stretching techniques.

legs.name: Knees and legs
legs.causes: Intense running or fitness, overworked quadriceps and hamstrings, a build-up of lactic acid and fatigue.
legs.treatmentDesc: Intense drainage of the legs and release of the tendons and muscle sheath for fast muscle recovery.

feet.name: Feet (reflexology)
feet.causes: Standing for long hours at work, uncomfortable shoes, flat feet and tension in the plantar fascia.
feet.treatmentDesc: Stimulation of the acupressure reflex points of the foot that eases your step and brings balance to the whole body.
feet.exerciseTitle: Rolling a tennis ball under the foot
